name: That Which is No Lie
acquisitionSource: Clear Operation: Astral Reign - Ch. 6 - When the Mountain Feasts
descriptionTemplate:
Gain [Block:Arg1] Shield, increase Realm Mastery by [Arg2]. If Caraboo is in the party, the next Caraboo's {derived:Caraboo's Blessing} will not trigger {Price}.
Scaling guide: {Primordia Mastery Scaling}
lore:
With it, the sin-steeped serpent tempted the pure and unknowing in Eden; with it, the envy-eaten queen deceived the snow-white, guiltless princess; with it, a mortal armed with nothing but cleverness outran the huntress of the wilds.
Yet this thing is no lie.
It is only that small, unspeakable desire nestled at the bottom of every human heart.
